principle: Tolerances are derived from functional interfaces and verified by stackup/inspection; manufacturing capability alone is not the acceptance basis.

functional_chain.function: Seat P007 repeatably against mating structure
functional_chain.datum_or_feature: Datum A = functional mating face set
functional_chain.method: derive from J2 contact/seal/preload function and inspection setup

functional_chain.function: Locate P007 axis relative to J2
functional_chain.datum_or_feature: Datum B = locator cylindrical feature / axis
functional_chain.method: H7/g6 radial fit plus controlled non-bottoming axial stack: P007 depth 2.00 ±0.05 / P003 pilot length 1.50 ±0.05

release_definition.C02: Ø14.10 H7; depth 2.00 ±0.05 mm from Datum A

functional_chain.method: ISO 5458 combined-zone pattern with TED PCD/equal spacing; MMR on P007 clearance-hole position preserves the T03 virtual boundary

release_definition.C04: 3× Ø2.90 H10 THRU; TED PCD Ø26.50; TED 120°; POSITION ⌀0.15 CZ Ⓜ | A | B

functional_chain.datum_or_feature: P007 OD10 / ID9.4 thin can zone
functional_chain.method: P007-side radial envelope: unilateral H9/h9 size limits preserve nominal clearances; TOTAL RUNOUT 0.02 to datum B allocates P007 alignment error. Counterpart P008/P015 production/alignment remain separate interface-release items.

release_definition.C11: TOTAL RUNOUT 0.02 | B on OD and ID

release_rule: K01-D-006 cannot be promoted until required functional tolerances have numeric limits, stackup/analysis evidence and inspection method.
